lines.trans: I like you—I have liked you for such a very long time.
Could you possibly like me back too?
Please do not chase me away just yet, alright?
Let me make one thing clear: I am not a stand-in to fill the gap when your boyfriend is away.
That is not what I meant—that is not what I meant at all!
I know that in my current situation, telling you I like you is out of line.
Yet just now I truly could not hold it back anymore.
Could you perhaps pretend I never said those words?
Except you already said them.
So what if I said them? Right now I feel like my everyday life is a joke.
Every day I tell myself I ought to feel happy, yet there is nothing I can do.

examples.text: 他的习惯是不带实习生的。
examples.trans: His habit is never taking on interns.

examples.text: 这就是我前两天的见闻。淳于总的过去有过洛琳，有过钟阳子，现在都已经不在他的生活里了。
examples.trans: That's what I witnessed overseas these past two days: Luo Lin and Zhong Yangzi were chapters of Mr Chun Yu's past, and neither is in his life anymore.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 最后留下的概率并不是很高。
examples.trans: The chance of staying on at the end is really not very high.

examples.text: 有些人的名字不能提，你提到他，他就会出现。
examples.trans: Some people's names must not be mentioned; if you mention him, he will appear.

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

examples.text: 你也不用太悲观了，可以试试云海卫视。
examples.trans: You do not need to be too pessimistic either; you can try Yunhai Television.

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

meanings.note: Short form dàn of 但是 ('but').

examples.text: 那是我们的失误，但不是原因。
examples.trans: That was our mistake, yet not the cause.

examples.text: 我还约了人，你们先回去吧。
examples.trans: I also have an appointment with someone; you two head back first.

examples.text: 我刚才听见她打电话了，她要出卖淳于总！
examples.trans: I just heard her making a phone call — she is going to betray Director Chun Yu!

examples.text: 我有一个办法解决这个问题。
examples.trans: I have a way to solve this problem.
He has no way to finish the performance.
It is not as if we only have one plan.

meanings.note: Classifier jù for spoken lines or sentences.

examples.text: 当时你一句都没有替自己辩解。
examples.trans: At the time you said not a single word in defence.

examples.text: 这一句光是古人注解就有三页。
examples.trans: Commentary on this single sentence fills three pages.

meanings.note: Adjective héshì ('right for the job, suitable').

examples.text: 我刚离开学校，做这件事很合适。
examples.trans: Having just graduated, I am well suited for this task.

examples.text: 这双鞋的大小正好合适。

meanings.note: transitive verb taking recipient and message

examples.trans: He did not tell me at all.

examples.text: 有新消息请马上告诉我。
examples.trans: Please tell me right away if there is new news.
Do you have a celebrity you like?

examples.text: 从喜欢的明星，就能看出一个人的性格。
examples.trans: From the celebrity someone likes, you can tell a person's personality.

填空.gloss: fill in the blanks; serve as an emotional stand-in

meanings.en: fill in the blanks; serve as an emotional stand-in
meanings.note: Literally filling exam blanks; figuratively filling lonely gaps.

examples.text: 感情需要真诚，谁也不愿只做别人孤单时用来填空的替代品。
examples.trans: Love needs sincerity—no one wants to be a mere stand-in.

examples.text: 请用合适的词语把句子里的空白处填空。
examples.trans: Please fill in the blanks in the sentence with suitable words.

meanings.note: Reduplicated noun tiāntiān functioning adverbially before the verb.

examples.trans: Your teacher praises you every day.
She stays up late every day lately.

examples.text: 感觉非常好，还要谢谢方老师推荐。
examples.trans: It feels great, and I also want to thank Professor Fang for the recommendation.

examples.text: 盛典将在今晚为您完全呈现。
examples.trans: The gala will be presented to you in full tonight.
I completely understand what you mean.

examples.text: 这两个人实在是太难搞了。
examples.trans: These two people are honestly impossible to handle.

examples.text: 今天工作太多，实在抽不开身。
examples.trans: There is so much work today I truly cannot step away.

examples.text: 待了半天我就回来了呗。
examples.trans: I stayed half a day and came back, that was all.

examples.text: 待了半天我就回来了呗。
examples.trans: I stayed half a day and came back, that was all.

examples.text: 那儿就是淳于乔的总编室。
examples.trans: Over there is Chun Yuqiao's chief editor's office.

examples.text: 你们俩的论文初稿都已经通过了。
examples.trans: Both of your first thesis drafts have already passed.

examples.text: 你们俩的论文初稿都已经通过了。
examples.trans: Both of your first thesis drafts have already passed.

examples.text: 那时候我每天都特别幸福。
examples.trans: Back then I was so happy every single day.

examples.text: 祝你们一家人永远幸福。
你真正的战场应该是在这边。
examples.trans: Your real battlefield should be over here.

examples.text: 现在可以一起共事，我好开心啊。
examples.trans: Getting to work together now makes me so happy.

examples.text: 我去那儿当实习生，就能上十二歌王的组。

meanings.note: Successfully keeping tears, laughter, or words inside.

examples.text: 本来不想说的，可刚才实在没忍住就说出来了。
examples.trans: I meant to stay quiet, yet just could not hold it back.

examples.text: 听到这个滑稽的借口，大家都没忍住笑出了声。
examples.trans: Hearing that comical excuse, nobody could hold back laughter.

meanings.note: Experiencing an emotion such as happiness, pride, or relief.

examples.text: 看到团队一起成长，他由衷地感到高兴。
examples.trans: Watching the team grow together made him genuinely happy.

examples.text: 每天勉强自己去感到幸福其实很累。
examples.trans: Forcing yourself to feel happy every day is exhausting.

examples.text: 下个星期的这个时候，我们要从现在就开始准备。
examples.trans: This time next week — we need to start preparing right from now.

meanings.note: emphatic adverb before negatives meaning 'not at all'

examples.trans: He did not tell me at all.

examples.text: 他根本不知道发生了什么事。
examples.trans: He has no idea at all what happened.

meanings.note: at sentence end, asks if an action has happened

examples.text: 工资还没拿呢，就干上活了？
examples.trans: You have not even collected your pay yet, and you have already started working?
President Ji, we are really pressed for time.

examples.text: 星天也在用我们提供的数据。
examples.trans: Xingtian is also using the data we provide.

examples.text: 她周末打算跟男朋友一起去逛画展。
examples.trans: She plans to visit an art show with her boyfriend this weekend.

examples.text: 不要老想着自己是实习生没经验。
examples.trans: Stop always thinking that you are an intern with no experience.
In a little while you will find out.

examples.text: 老板难得讲个笑话，可惜听起来有点老套。
examples.trans: The boss rarely cracks a joke, though it sounded a bit dated.

examples.text: 大家听了他的冷笑话都忍不住笑了起来。
examples.trans: Hearing his dry joke, everyone could not help laughing.

examples.text: 我去那儿当实习生，就能上十二歌王的组。

examples.trans: The chairwoman rushed onto a night flight back too.

examples.text: 我跟他不一样，我要了一个实习生的名额。
